title: MaleTheme Solo #003 · 남 클래식 머슬·펄 화이트 글로시·악마 테마·메탈릭
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Ukrainian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, fair smooth skin, a shy sweet smile, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a pair of small curved black horns on his head, a thin pointed devil tail, a black leather collar, and a minimal glossy mirror-polished metallic black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
